title: Build a Few-Shot Prompt
statement: Read an integer n, then n lines each formatted as 'input|output' (a few-shot example pair separated by a pipe). Then read one final line, the query. Print the few-shot prompt: for each example i (1-indexed, in the order given), print 'Example <i>: Input: <input> -> Output: <output>'. Finally print 'Query: <query>'.
starter_code:
n = int(input())
examples = []
for _ in range(n):
    line = input()
    inp, out = line.split("|")
    examples.append((inp, out))
query = input()
# TODO: print each numbered example line, then the final Query line
hints: enumerate(examples, start=1) gives you the 1-indexed example number alongside each (input, output) pair
Print all example lines first, then the Query line last
